entries.test: Contemporaneous search-quality evidence, user behavior, and major coverage of Bing's ChatGPT integration could establish whether Google's search changes harmed its service and gave Bing a competitive opening.
entries.note: 'Everybody wished' is rhetorical emphasis within an otherwise testable causal claim. 'Unquestionably' expresses certainty, not a condition.

entries.test: Evidence of changes in Google's search quality, together with Bard's announced functions and Google's launch messaging, could establish whether Google presented a remedy for its own search shortcomings as innovation.
entries.note: 'Broke' has a plain contextual reading of degraded search usefulness, rather than literal failure to operate.
